subject: The application failed to start - listen EADDRNOTAVAIL

messages.author: 5ad69edcd6816251
messages.subject: The application failed to start - listen EADDRNOTAVAIL
parts:
The server has been running Shiny/R for a while, with no issues at all. Now, all of a sudden this error occurs for all hosted apps.


The default webpage is shown, but the two boxes where test apps should show up, only show this:

"An error has occurred

The application failed to start.

listen EADDRNOTAVAIL"


In the log for shiny-server, I find this:

[INFO] shiny-server - ^[[39mStarting listener on 0.0.0.0:3838
[INFO] shiny-server - ^[[39mError getting worker: Error: The application exited during initialization.


I have been banging my head against the wall, to no avail - so if anyone has any idea where I can start to look to fix this, it will be highly appreciated.


Sincerely,

Even
